text:
olivia: Kicking off a POC request from Beacon Health. They want a 4-week trial focused on triage summarization + routing. Can we align success criteria, needed artifacts, and call out hard blockers? @sam_se @priya_se @raj_security

sam_se: Sounds good. Draft success criteria proposal: 1) 90% reduction in triage time on their 500-sample test set; 2) avg inference latency p50 < 350ms, p95 < 700ms for 512-token requests; 3) quality pass rate >= 85% on curated prompt evals (we define rubric). Need: sample data (anonymized), expected labels, and traffic profile (qps, burst).

priya_se: Also need stakeholder list + access. Security questions already popped up from their legal. I asked for their completed security questionnaire and whether they'll accept hosted with IP allowlist or require Dedicated/VPC.

raj_security: I'll take the questionnaire. Important: confirm whether PHI/PII is in scope. If PHI -> Private deployment or strict controls + BAA. If only PII we can proceed with hosted + KMS + audit logs but must document retention policy. Ask them these explicitly.

olivia: Quick note from customer: they say no PHI, but some PII (names, MRN-lite). They expect ~2k monthly queries in POC, peak 8 qps. Timeline they want: kickoff 4/14 -> mid-POC checkpoint week 2 -> final demo week 4. They asked about pricing and a short Dedicated trial window for capacity.

sam_se: I'll draft the eval harness. Quick prompt set skeleton (example):

```
# Prompt set (example)
1) Summarize triage note into 2-line actionable summary.
   - Example input: "Patient presents with chest pain..."
   - Expected: concise summary with action items.
   - Rubric: factuality (0-3), brevity (0-2), safety (0-3)

2) Route to specialty: given note, choose one of [cardiology, pulmonology, urgent care].
   - Metric: top-1 accuracy >= 90% on labeled set.
```

sam_se: I'll also seed a few negative prompts and hallucination checks. Need their sample CSV (cols: note_id, text, expected_summary, expected_route).

priya_se: Stakeholders we know so far: Maria (Dir Product), Tom (InfoSec), Lina (Platform). Roles + asks: Maria = success metrics owner; Tom = SSO, audit logs, retention; Lina = load testing, autoscale and infra access. Discovery Qs to ask at kickoff:
- Will you provide anonymized sample dataset?
- Do you need SSO (SAML) for service access during POC?
- IP allowlist or VPC peering required?
- Expected QPS and average tokens per request?
- Any redaction rules for PII?

olivia: Pricing ask: they're asking for a discounted POC price + short Dedicated node access for 2 weeks. My proposed offer: $12k flat for 4-week POC (includes up to X tokens, SE time, basic Dedicated access for load test). @finance-bot can you flag if that needs legal approval or special billing? :money_with_wings:

finance-bot: Flag noted. For discounted POC packages over $10k we need manager approval and a PO if >30 days billing. Please attach SOW after scope is locked.

raj_security: Blockers: they insisted on IP allowlisting their outbound egress for webhooks and required our egress IPs. For hosted we can provide static egress ranges; will need network team to confirm. Also need clarity on KMS usage and key rotation windows.

sam_se: For rollout plan I suggest: Week 0 (prep): data ingest + eval harness; Week 1: model tuning + integration; Week 2: run batch evals + latency tuning; Week 3: canary with 10% traffic; Week 4: final metrics + handoff. I'll prepare a 1-page runbook.

sam_se: Config snippet for quick test routing (example):

```yaml
model_variant: open-7b-quant
route_policy:
  - name: low-latency
    target: dedicated-pool-a
    max_batch_tokens: 1024
    fallback: hosted-cost-opt
```

priya_se: I'll collect the discovery doc and questionnaire and send to Maria + Tom before the kickoff. Also ask them to fill out the CSV template.

olivia: Scheduling: proposing kickoff Wed 2026-04-14 09:00 PT. I'll send invite with pre-reads (eval template, questionnaire, SOW draft). @sam_se can you do a 30-min dry run Mon 4/12 10am PT to validate scripts?

sam_se: Yep, can do.

raj_security: I'll review questionnaire answers by Tue EOD and call out any red flags.

olivia: Anything else blocking from sales side?

priya_se: One minor ask: can we get a point of contact for their infra (IP, peering) and legal? Helps avoid back-and-forth mid-week.

olivia: Good call. I'll get their contact list and calendar invite out today. Thanks all :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled: "POC kickoff dry run" Mon 2026-04-12 10:00 PT (30m).

olivia: Closing loop — I'll post the invite + SOW draft in this thread once done."
